proposal.reason: Main change is in runtime kernel planning/launch: plans now pass explicit argument buffer pointer+byte size to kernel launch and raise the shared kernel-arg budget/capacity to 4 KiB. Add symmetric because multi-task symmetric scheduling now allocates and owns variable-sized argument buffers differently (scoped allocation, size tracking, and error-path behavior). Add kernels because built-in collective kernel entry signatures and shared device argument storage type changed from 1 KiB to 4 KiB, which is a device-kernel ABI/interface change.
